prompt.alinti: Stewie, I just built a website that looks like it costs $10,000 with literally one line of code, using Claude for free.
Step one, you install Claude code in your terminal.
Step two, you add the UI UX Pro Max skill so Claude builds clean modern layouts automatically.
Step 3, you pull a hero section from 21st its dev and paste it straight in.
Step 4, you drop in Framer Motion and every section animates itself.
We wrapped all 4 into one single repo so you literally paste one line and Claude builds the whole thing.
Check the link in bio for the ultimate repo.
